# 6. Amends regulation 7 of the principal regulations.
Sub-regulation (2) of regulation 7 of the principal regulations shall be substituted by the following new sub-regulation:
"(2) The maximum electricity generated by solar photovoltaic installations and exported to the distribution system established in the Third Schedule shall be composed of electricity generated and exported to the distribution system by solar photovoltaic installations approved by the Regulator for the payment of the feed in tariff during the years for which the thresholds for electricity generated and exported to the distribution system has been established.".
